lead: The pre-check refuses the runtime's own report too, and it fails as an empty string.
body: A request reaching `rule:errors/on-limit`'s tier 1 is past its balance, so every `NvsStr::new` on the reporting path answers the immortal empty and the handler gets a record whose keys are `""`. Hold `nvs_runtime::budget::Reporting` across the whole escalation, as `Ctx::run_limit_handler` and `nvs_host::ladder` do.
